newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets see patchy, modest trade.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets see patchy, modest trade.

text.p: Europe's raw cotton markets saw patchy trade at low prices on Thursday, industry sources said.

Central Asian and West African medium and better qualities found modest demand in Portugal, Italy and Belgium and traders noted further interest in U.S. descriptions for second quarter shipment from buyers in Turkey.

Interest in long staple cottons was described by one source as meagre. The Cotlook "A' Index was quoted unchanged after a lack of fresh price developments in sparse trade. -London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
